title: SNATCH – Frozen
description:
Snatch Frozen Ultra Strong is a super strong nicotine pouch with the classic taste of mint. The intense deep-frozen feeling you get when using Snatch Frozen together with it’s high nicotine content of 30mg/g is truly the ultimate combination. All pouches are 100% tobacco free and all white. The can offers 22 pouches absolutely packed with mint flavor and due to it’s perfectly slimmed shape, every one of them sits discretely under your lip.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 30

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 21

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Manufacturer: Consumer Brands International
